book.name: Yohana
book.title: Amangʼana amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Yohana

content: Yeesu aragya Yerusaremu mu Nyaangi ye Ebhihuuna
Ambe, okuhita gayo, Yeesu akataanga okwiiruguura mukyaaro kya Gariraaya. Ateendiri kwiiruguura mukyaaro kya Yudea, kwo okubha abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi bhaari bhareenda kumwiita.
Eriibhaga riyo, Enyaangi ye Ebhihuuna ya Abhayahudi
yaari yiisukiri.
Niho bhawamwaabhu Yeesu bhakamubhuurira, “Otasaaga hano, ogye Yudea, okubha abhaanabheega bhaazo bharore ebhitiika bhino okukora.
Eraabhe omuutu areenda amenyekane kubhaatu, atakukora emirimo gyaaye kwa mbiso. Ambe, kwo okubha oranagya kukora amangʼana gayo, noogye wiiyeerekye kubhaatu bhoosi, okubha bhakumenye.”
Bhawamwaabhu bhakagaamba ego, kwo okubha naabhe ebho abheene bhataamwiikiriirye kubha Yeesu ni Masiya.
Niho Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Eriibhaga ryaane, rikyaari kuhika, nawe emwe muranagya kugya eriibhaga ryoryoosi.
Abhaatu bhe ekyaaro kino, bhatana ekigirirye kyo okubhiihirirwa emwe. Nawe bharanibhiihirirya enye, kwe ekigirirye ndabhabhuurira, amahokya gaabhu ni mabhi.
Emwe abheene, mugye Yerusaremu kuginiha enyaangi. Enye nitakugya, kwe ekigirirye eriibhaga ryaane rikyaari kuhika.”
Hano Yeesu yamariri okugaamba amangʼana gayo, akasaaga Gariraaya.
Nawe hano abhahiiri bhaaye bhaari bhagiiri Yerusaremu kuginiha enyaangi yiyo, Yeesu neewe akagya eyo, nawe kwa mbiso, atiiyeerekirye kubhweero.
Ambe, eriibhaga riyo, abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi bhakataanga kumukomya Yeesu munyaangi yiyo. Bhaari bharabhuurya abhaatu, “Ari hayi omuutu wurya?”
Abhaatu bhaaru bhaari bharahakana iguru wa Yeesu, abhaandi bhakagaamba, “Ni muutu muzomu,” nawe abhaandi bhaari bharabhuga, “Zeyi, arakaangirirya abhaatu.”
Nawe ataari ariho omuutu wuno yaari akumugaamba Yeesu kubhweero, kwo okubha bhaari bharoobhoha abhakaangati bhayo.
Yeesu areegya abhaatu mwiiseengerero
Hano eziisiku zye enyaangi zyahikiri gatigati, Yeesu akagya, akasikira mwiiseengerero, akataanga okweegya abhaatu.
Niho Abhayahudi bhakaruguura kwa ameegyo gaaye, bhakabhuga, “Mbe, igabhwi omuutu wuno aranagya okumenya goosi gano, neewe akyaari kweegibhwa bhukongʼu?”
Ambe, Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Ameegyo gano nikweegya, gatari gaane, nawe garwiiri kuwuno yaanitumiri.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akweenda kukora bhino Taatabhugya akweenda, wuyo aramenya eraabhe, ameegyo gaane garwiiri ku Taatabhugya, kasi enye ndiigaambira omweene ego.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akugaamba kwo obhuturo bhwaaye omweene, wuyo ariikomeerya obhuguungo ewe omweene. Nawe wuno akukomya obhuguungo kuwuno akamutuma, wuyo aragaamba obhuheene, atakugaamba orurimi.
Mumenyiri kubha, Musa akabhaha emigiro gya Taatabhugya. Nawe atariho omuutu gati weenyu wuno akugwaata emigiro giyo. Kwaki mureenda kuniita?”
Abhaatu bhayo bhakamukyoora, “One eriisaambwa eriibhi awe! Ni weewi wuno akweenda kukwiita?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Nikakora ekitiika kimwe hano murusiku rwo okumuunya, na neemwe bhoosi mukaruguura.
Rora, Musa akabharagania okusaara
abhaana bheenyu abhasubhe. Etari kubha enyaangi yiyo ekarwa ku Musa omweene, nawe ekarweera kubhazaazi bheenyu bho okutaanga.
Bhoono naabhe emwe murakora emirimo murusiku rwo okumuunya, kwe ekigirye murasaara abhaana bheenyu abhasubhe naabhe murusiku ruyo.
Ambe naabhe murusiku rwo okumuunya murasaara abhaana, okubha omugiro gwa Musa gutaaza gukasarika. Ndora murantiindira hano nikumuhorya omuutu murusiku rwo okumuunya?
Mutatinira ekiina omuutu kutuukana na amangʼana gano gakurorekana igutu, nawe omutinire ekiina omuutu kwe eheene.”
Abhaatu bhariibhuurya eraabhe Yeesu niwe Masiya
Ambe, abhaatu abhaandi bha Yerusaremu hayo, bhakabha bhariibhuurya, “Mbe, omuutu wuno atari wuno abhakaangati bheetu bhakweenda kumwiita?
Rora, bhoono aragaamba kubhweero, nawe ebho bhatakumubhuurira kyokyoosi! Mbe, eraturikana kubha, abhakaangati bheetu neebho bhoosi bhamenyiiri kubha, wuyo niwe Masiya?
Nawe omuutu wuno, tumenyiri hano arwiiri. Hano Masiya omweene akuuza, atariho omuutu wuno akumenya hano arwiiri.”

Hano Yeesu yaari akweegya mwiiseengerero, akatiirya eriiraka akubhuga, “Eheene munimenyiri, na mumenyiri hano nikurwa. Enye nitiiziri kwo obhuturo bhwaane, nawe nikatumwa na Taatabhugya we eheene. Emwe mutamumenyiri.
Enye nimumenyiri, kwe ekigirirye nirwiiri kweewe, na niwe akaanituma.”
Niho abhaatu bhakeenda okumugwaata, nawe ataari ariho omuutu wuno akamugwaata, kwe ekigirirye eriibhaga ryaaye ryaari rikyaari kuhika.
Nawe gati wa abhaatu, bhaari bhariho bhaaru bhano bhakamwiikirirya Yeesu. Abhaatu bhayo bhakabhuga, “Hano Masiya araaze, eheene atakuuza kukora ebhitiika bhyaaru kukira bhino omuutu wuno akoriri.”
Abhasirikare bharatumwa okumugwaata Yeesu

Ambe, Abhafarisayo bhakiigwa kyeego esaango ya abhaatu bhakumoonyerera ego iguru wa Yeesu. Kweego, Abhafarisayo bhayo, hamwe na abhakuru bha abhaseengeri, bhakaragania abhasirikare okubha bhamugwaate Yeesu.
Niho Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaatu bhayo, “Ndabha na neemwe kwe eriibhaga iguhi ego. Okumara ndakyoora kuwuno yaanitumiri.
Muraankomya, nawe mutakuumbona. Kweeki, hano nkugya enye, emwe mutakunagya kuuza.”

Niho Abhayahudi bhakakeerenia, “Mbe, omuutu wuno aragya hayi hano etwe tutakunagya okumubhona? Mbe, areenda kugya ku Bhayahudi bhano bhanyarageeni mubhyaaro ebhiindi, no okweegya abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi?
Mbe, obhugazuro bhwaku niki hano akubhuga, ‘Muraankomya, nawe mutakuumbona. Kweeki, hano nkugya enye, emwe mutakunagya kuuza’?”
Yeesu arakeerenia okuuza kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru
Orusiku rwo okumariirya Enyaangi ye Ebhihuuna, rwaari orusiku orukuru. Ambe, Yeesu akiimeerera mwiiseengerero, akabhuga kwe eriiraka ikuru, “Omuutu akwiigwa enyoota, yiize kweenye, anywe!
Amakaamo Amahoreeru garabhuga, omuutu wowoosi wuno akuniikirirya enye, ‘Emisabhuko gya amaanzi go obhuhoru giragera okurwa muusi waaye.’ ”

Yeesu yaari arakeerenerya Ekoro Muhoreeru, wuno abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakumwiikirirya Yeesu bharamusuungʼaana. Eriibhaga riyo, Taatabhugya yaari akyaari kutuma Ekoro waaye kweebho, kwe ekigirirye yaari akyaari kweerekya kubhweero obhuguungo bhwa Yeesu.
Abhaatu bharatwaanikana kwe ekigirirye kya Yeesu
Ambe abhaatu abhaandi musaango yiyo bhakiigwa amangʼana gayo, bhakabhuga, “Eheene, omuutu wuno niwe omurooti wurya wuno tukumuganya okurwa ku Taatabhugya.”
Abhaatu abhaandi bhakabhuga, “Omuutu wuno niwe Masiya.” Nawe abhaandi bhakabhuga, “Zeyi, Masiya atakunagya okurwa mukyaaro kya Gariraaya.
Mbe, Amakaamo Amahoreeru gatakugaamba, Masiya ararweera murwiibhuro rwo omutemi Daudi?
Kweeki kubha, ariibhurwa mu Beterehemu, mumugye guno Daudi akiibhurwa?”
Kweego abhaatu bhakatwaanikana kwe ekigirirye kya Yeesu.
Abhaandi bhakeenda okumugwaata, nawe ataari ariho omuutu wuno yasakirye kumugwaata, kwe ekigirirye eriibhaga ryaaye ryaari rikyaari kuhika.
Abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi bhatakumwiikiriirya Yeesu
Ambe, abhasirikare bhayo bhakakyoora kubhakuru bha abhaseengeri na Abhafarisayo. Abhakaangati bhayo bhakabhabhuurya, “Kwaki mutaamugwaatiri Yeesu no okumureeta hano?”
Abhasirikare bhayo bhakakyoora, “Tukyaari kwiigwa omuutu owuundi wuno akunagya kugaamba kyeego ewe arabhuga.”
Kyaamwe Abhafarisayo bhakabhabhuurya, “Mbe, naabhe emwe mumariri kukaangiribhwa neewe?
Bhoono ariho omukaangati wowoosi wurya kasi Omufarisayo naabhe wumwe wuno akumwiikirirya?
Nawe abhaatu bhano bhakumwiikirirya, ni saango ya abhaatu bhano bhatamenyiri emigiro gya Musa. Bhiihiimirwe na Taatabhugya!”
Niho Nikodemo, owumwe wa abhakaangati bha Abhafarisayo wuno yaari amariri kugya ku Yeesu orusiku rumwe obhutiku, akabhuurya abharikyaaye,
“Mbe, emigiro gyeetu giriikirirya okumutinira ekiina omuutu eno tukyaari kumwiitegeerera no okumenya gano akoriri?”
Ebho bhakamukyoora Nikodemo, “Mbe, woosi orwiiri Gariraaya? Noogye wiisuunze bhuzomu Amakaamo Amahoreeru, no oramenya kubha, atariho omurooti wuno akurweera Gariraaya!”

footnotes.text: Enyaangi ye Ebhihuuna ya Abhayahudi yaari enyaangi yino Abhayahudi bhahaaginihya amagesa ge emizabibu ne emizeituni, no okusabha bhabhone embura yo omwaaka guno gukuuza, bhahiikara mubhihuuna bhya amatu ge emiti. Bhahaahiita bhazaazi bhaabhu bhano bhaageendiri no okwiikara mukibhara emyaaka miroongo ene (40). Rora Abharaawi 23:33-36, 39-43; Obhuhiiti bhwe Emigiro 16:13-16.
a Okusaara. Rora engʼana okusaarwa mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
b Bhazaazi bheenyu bho okutaanga bhaari Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo.

Mu Nyaangi ye Ebhihuuna, Abhayahudi bhaari bharamusabha Taatabhugya embura, no okuhiita kubha Taatabhugya yaari abhaheeri bhazaazi bhaabhu amaanzi mukibhara. Rora Okurwa 17:1-7; Obhubhari 20:1-11. Yeesu arakumiirirya kubha ewe ni musabhuko gwa amaanzi ge eheene.
a Daudi. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
